gold_sql:
SELECT ST_Value(rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.747217 41.655827)',4326)) AS elevation
FROM public.dem_us
WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.747217 41.655827)',4326))
LIMIT 1;
